Serve title.title: Made for every kind of hospitality.

Serve intro.paragraph: Whether you run a resort, a fine-dining room or a neighbourhood café, we tailor the range to your service style.

Sector hotels desc.paragraph: All-day dining, banquets, room service and pool.

Sector restaurants desc.paragraph: Fine dining to casual — tableware with character.

Sector cafes desc.paragraph: Durable, beautiful pieces for high turnover.

Sector banquets desc.paragraph: Buffet, display and service for every event size.

style.Serve head: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px; @media(--tablet){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; }
style.Serve head left: flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; padding: 0px; width: 700px; max-width: 100%;
style.Serve head right: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 0px; width: 420px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start;
style.Sector cards: padding: 0px; gap: 20px; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(1, auto); @media(--tablet){ grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(2, auto); gap: 40px; } @media(--mobile){ grid-template-columns: repeat(1, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(4, auto); gap: 36px; }
style.Sector hotels: flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; padding: 0px; align-items: stretch;
style.Sector hotels row: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
style.Sector hotels title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 28px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 26px; }
style.Sector hotels arrow: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; color: var(--on-gold);
style.Sector restaurants: flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; padding: 0px; align-items: stretch;
style.Sector restaurants row: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
style.Sector restaurants title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 28px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 26px; }
style.Sector restaurants arrow: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; color: var(--on-gold);
style.Sector cafes: flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; padding: 0px; align-items: stretch;
style.Sector cafes row: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
style.Sector cafes title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 28px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 26px; }
style.Sector cafes arrow: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; color: var(--on-gold);
style.Sector banquets: flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; padding: 0px; align-items: stretch;
style.Sector banquets row: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
style.Sector banquets title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 28px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 26px; }
style.Sector banquets arrow: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; color: var(--on-gold);
